title: Jordan from Sonica predicts the next day's conflict in the sky
summary: James Valor tells of Jordan from Sonica predicts the next day's conflict in the sky, about 2025 at Skywatcher field operation (unspecified), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Jordan, our leading specialist from Sonica, came up to me and Alex and said, "Hey, tomorrow we will see conflict in the sky.

plain: James Valor works with Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call UFOs into view. On the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels in 2025, he says that a team member named Jordan, whom he calls their leading specialist from a group called Sonica, came up to him and a colleague, Alex, at one of their field operations and said they would "see conflict in the sky" the next day. If true, the story would mean a person could know ahead of time what would show up in the sky.
